metadata.document: Card game persistence Group E owner approval
metadata.approval_scope: E-001 through E-010; isolated Card Engine v2 implementation and temporary/dedicated SQLite tests

approved_decisions.rule: Monotonic state_revision per match, mirrored in persisted row and state envelope; requests carry expected_revision.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus explicit compare-and-swap update in the same transaction; local single-host SQLite WAL only.
Durable operation ledger unique by match_id and operation_id, request fingerprint, replay on identical request and conflict on different fingerprint.
Atomic commit for snapshot, revision, operation ledger, events, projections/counters, rewards and outbox.
Append-only event journal with strict per-match sequence; human-readable event_log is not the source of truth.
Transactional outbox with at-least-once delivery, lease, retry, dead-letter and consumer idempotency key.
Checksummed migration ledger; checksum mismatch is a hard failure.
Immutable SQLite Backup API backup, quick_check, integrity_check, SHA-256 and source snapshot preservation.
Existing active/pending matches remain on legacy engine; finished legacy matches read-only; new v2 matches only after integrated gates; never invent missing provenance.
Deterministic one-time snapshot migration plan with dry-run, persisted UUIDv4 occurrence mapping, provenance preservation when available, invariant checks and rollback.

explicit_exclusions: No production database migration or schema alteration is authorized by this approval.
No runtime, bot, HTTP, Discord, frontend or legacy engine integration is authorized yet.
No cutover or conversion of active matches is authorized.
No multi-host use of SQLite WAL is authorized.
